items_flat.title_en: OpenAI models and Codex coming to Google Cloud Model Garden
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI模型與Codex即將進入Google Cloud Model Garden
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a partnership with Google Cloud to bring its frontier models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, plus Codex agentic workflows into Google Cloud’s Model Garden. Customers can purchase via Google Cloud Marketplace and draw down GCP commitments; models will also reach Google Antigravity and Gemini Agent. General availability is planned in the coming weeks. Microsoft remains OpenAI’s primary cloud partner.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布與Google Cloud合作，將其前沿模型（含GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol與GPT-6 Luna）及Codex代理工作流帶入Google Cloud Model Garden。客戶可透過Google Cloud Marketplace購買並抵用GCP承諾額度；模型亦將進入Google Antigravity與Gemini Agent。預計未來數週正式推出。Microsoft仍為OpenAI主要雲端夥伴。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands OpenAI’s enterprise distribution beyond Microsoft and AWS to all three major US hyperscalers, reducing lock-in for customers while creating complex competitive dynamics among cloud providers. Timing of full availability and how safety standards are enforced across partners remain key variables.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將OpenAI企業通路從Microsoft與AWS擴展至三大美國超大規模雲端供應商，降低客戶鎖定效應，同時加劇雲端商間競爭。完整推出時間與夥伴間安全標準執行仍是關鍵變數。
items_flat.quote: This partnership is an important step in making our most capable models and Codex available where customers are already building, giving them even more choice in how they use frontier AI.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此合作是將我們最強大模型與Codex帶到客戶已在建置之處的重要一步，讓他們在使用前沿AI時擁有更多選擇。

items_flat.title_en: Thousands of GPT-Rosalind agents analyze brain CRISPR data in 32 minutes
items_flat.title_zh: 數千個GPT-Rosalind代理在32分鐘內分析大腦CRISPR數據
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps Research used thousands of distributed AI agents powered by GPT-Rosalind to analyze a whole-brain CRISPR atlas of millions of mouse brain cells in 32 minutes. The agents linked gene disruptions to literature and proposed novel hypotheses, including differences between Tsc1/Tsc2 and a cholesterol-neurodegeneration connection. A reasoning atlas is publicly available; human experts preferred distributed-agent reports.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI、PerturbAI與Scripps Research使用數千個由GPT-Rosalind驅動的分散式AI代理，在32分鐘內分析涵蓋數百萬小鼠大腦細胞的全腦CRISPR圖譜。代理將基因干擾連結至文獻並提出新假設，包括Tsc1/Tsc2差異與膽固醇-神經退化連結。推理圖譜已公開；人類專家較偏好分散式代理報告。
items_flat.analysis_en: This demonstrates practical multi-agent scientific reasoning at scale on real biological datasets, compressing months of analysis. Follow-up experimental validation of the novel hypotheses will determine real-world impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這展示了多代理科學推理在真實生物數據集上的實用規模化應用，將數月分析壓縮至數十分鐘。新假設的後續實驗驗證將決定實際影響。
items_flat.quote: Working together, OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used thousands of AI agents powered by GPT‑Rosalind to analyze and interpret existing experimental data from millions of mouse brain cells in just 32 minutes.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI、PerturbAI與Scripps Research共同使用數千個由GPT-Rosalind驅動的AI代理，僅用32分鐘分析並解讀數百萬小鼠大腦細胞的現有實驗數據。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI leads coordinated disclosure of critical PHP vulnerabilities found with models
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI主導協調揭露以模型發現的PHP重大漏洞
items_flat.summary_en: As part of its Patch the Planet initiative, OpenAI coordinated a two-month response with maintainers, researchers and providers to critical PHP vulnerabilities (including one discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol). The flaws affect a widely used language; PHP maintainers led fixes, with partners including Wiz and Cloudflare. OpenAI committed $1 billion in subsidized Daybreak access for frontline defenders and shared a proposed AI-era vulnerability response framework.
items_flat.summary_zh: 作為Patch the Planet倡議的一部分，OpenAI與維護者、研究人員及供應商協調了為期兩個月的回應，處理PHP重大漏洞（其中一個由GPT-5.6 Sol發現）。這些缺陷影響廣泛使用的語言；PHP維護者主導修復，夥伴包括Wiz與Cloudflare。OpenAI承諾向一線防禦者提供10億美元補貼Daybreak存取，並分享AI時代漏洞回應框架。
items_flat.analysis_en: It shows frontier models contributing to high-impact open-source security at internet scale, with defenders getting a window ahead of attackers. The early leak risk and intricate coordination across maintainers, providers and governments highlight the operational complexity of scaling such responses.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示前沿模型對網際網路規模開源安全的高影響力貢獻，讓防禦者領先攻擊者取得時間窗口。早期洩漏風險與跨維護者、供應商及政府的複雜協調，凸顯規模化此類回應的操作複雜性。
items_flat.quote: Over the past two months, we led a coalition of maintainers, researchers, and security providers to address critical vulnerabilities in PHP... Calif identified a critical flaw using GPT‑5.6 Sol as part of our Patch the Planet initiative.
items_flat.quote_zh: 過去兩個月，我們領導由維護者、研究人員與安全供應商組成的聯盟，處理PHP重大漏洞……Calif使用GPT-5.6 Sol作為Patch the Planet倡議的一部分發現了一個重大缺陷。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens research preview of Claude Duet proactive agent
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開放Claude Duet主動代理研究預覽
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched a research preview of Claude Duet, a standalone proactive agent app for professionals and small-business owners. Built around Claude Opus 5.5, it monitors connected apps, sends morning briefs, works in the background via a virtual machine, and requires approval for sensitive actions. Available via waitlist to US Pro and Max subscribers on iOS, Android and claude.ai; shares existing usage limits.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Duet研究預覽，這是一款針對專業人士與小企業主的獨立主動代理應用。圍繞Claude Opus 5.5打造，它監控連接應用、發送晨間簡報、透過虛擬機在背景工作，並在敏感行動前需核准。透過等待名單向美國Pro與Max訂閱者開放，支援iOS、Android與claude.ai；共用現有使用額度。
items_flat.analysis_en: Claude Duet enters a crowded field of always-on agents (OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse) with a work-focused design and strong safety emphasis. Early availability is limited; reliability of judgment on urgency and broader rollout will determine competitive impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Claude Duet進入擁擠的常駐代理領域（OpenAI Dots、Meta Muse），採工作導向設計並強調安全。初期可用性有限；對緊急程度判斷的可靠性與更廣泛推出將決定競爭影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re opening a research preview of Claude Duet, a new app where Claude works as a proactive agent. It comes to you with what needs your attention, completes tasks you ask of it, keeps working even when you step away, and checks with you before it acts on your behalf.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們開放Claude Duet研究預覽，這是一款Claude作為主動代理的新應用。它主動帶來需要你關注的事項、完成你交代的任務、即使你離開也持續工作，並在代表你行動前與你確認。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries, reaching 89 total
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT廣告擴展至26個新國家，總計達89國
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT Ads to 26 additional countries (including more of Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia), bringing total availability to 89 countries. Over 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns since launch; ads appear only on Free and Go plans. The company reiterated that ads are clearly labeled, do not influence answers, and conversations remain private from advertisers.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI將ChatGPT廣告擴展至另外26個國家（涵蓋更多拉丁美洲、歐洲、非洲與亞洲），總計可用性達89國。自推出以來已有超過10萬廣告主投放；廣告僅出現在Free與Go方案。公司重申廣告清楚標示、不影響回答，且對話對廣告主保持私密。
items_flat.analysis_en: The expansion accelerates monetization of free users to support broader access, with a reported path toward $1B annualized ad revenue. It tests user trust as conversational ads scale, and further format or measurement expansions could shift the experience.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此擴展加速免費用戶變現以支持更廣泛存取，據報有望朝向10億美元年化廣告收入。隨著對話式廣告規模化，這考驗用戶信任，進一步格式或衡量擴展可能改變體驗。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re expanding ChatGPT Ads to 26 additional countries, extending availability to 89 countries worldwide... Advertising helps support free and low-cost access to ChatGPT for people around the world.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將ChatGPT廣告擴展至另外26個國家，將可用性延伸至全球89國……廣告有助支持全球人們免費與低成本存取ChatGPT。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI aligns safety standards across partners and updates Usage Policies
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI對齊夥伴安全標準並更新使用政策
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced work to align safety policies across services that provide its models, including partners and resellers. Updated Usage Policies (effective November 20, 2026) require prior review for model-access intermediaries and clarify rules for sensitive uses. The company introduced SafetyIDs for more precise misuse response without learning end-user identities.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布致力於對齊提供其模型之服務（含夥伴與轉售商）的安全政策。更新後的使用政策（2026年11月20日生效）要求模型存取中介服務事先審查，並釐清敏感用途規則。公司推出SafetyIDs，以便更精準回應濫用而不得知終端用戶身份。
items_flat.analysis_en: As OpenAI’s models become available through more third-party platforms, consistent safeguards become operationally critical. Enforcement effectiveness and partner compliance will be tested as distribution expands.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 隨著OpenAI模型透過更多第三方平台提供，一致的防護措施在操作上變得至關重要。隨著通路擴張，執法效力與夥伴合規將受考驗。
items_flat.quote: Developers and businesses should be able to choose where they access our models, with consistent safeguards across those services.
items_flat.quote_zh: 開發者與企業應能選擇存取我們模型的地方，並在這些服務間享有一致的防護措施。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes blueprint for empowering cyber defenders
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI發布賦能網路防禦者的藍圖
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released Part II of its democratic governance series: a blueprint for empowering cyber defenders. It proposes clearer responsibilities for securing frontier models, modernizing cybersecurity tools and training, and strengthening public institutions for evaluations and incident reporting. This builds on prior work and the $1B Daybreak commitment for frontline defenders.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布民主治理系列第二部分：賦能網路防禦者的藍圖。它提出加強前沿模型安全責任、現代化網路安全工具與培訓，以及強化公共機構評估與事件報告。這建立在先前工作與為一線防禦者提供的10億美元Daybreak承諾之上。
items_flat.analysis_en: The blueprint frames a limited ‘defender’s window’ before advanced offensive capabilities become widespread. Concrete policy uptake by governments will determine whether the proposals translate into operational advantage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 藍圖框定在進階攻擊能力廣泛普及前的有限「防禦者窗口」。政府對具體政策的採納程度，將決定這些提案能否轉化為操作優勢。
items_flat.quote: We are in a defender’s window: a limited opportunity to put advanced AI into defenders’ hands and strengthen protections before advanced cyber offensive capabilities become widely available.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正處於防禦者窗口：在進階網路攻擊能力廣泛可用之前，將先進AI交到防禦者手中並加強保護的有限機會。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to advance AI in drug development
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI收購Orchestra Bio以推進AI藥物開發
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform that helps biopharma teams coordinate drug development with AI agents. The team and technology will join Rosalind, OpenAI’s life-sciences models and tools. The goal is to connect scientific findings with operational next steps so treatments reach patients sooner.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI收購Orchestra Bio，這是一款協助生物製藥團隊以AI代理協調藥物開發的平台。團隊與技術將加入Rosalind，即OpenAI的生命科學模型與工具。目標是將科學發現與操作下一步連結，讓治療更快到達患者。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal deepens OpenAI’s vertical push into biopharma operations beyond pure research models. Integration success and measurable cycle-time reductions will show whether agentic tooling meaningfully shortens the 10–15-year drug timeline.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易深化OpenAI從純研究模型進一步進入生物製藥操作的垂直布局。整合成功與否與可衡量的週期縮短，將顯示代理工具能否實質縮短10–15年的藥物時間軸。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform that helps biopharma teams coordinate the complex process of drug development. We’re bringing Orchestra’s team and technology together with Rosalind.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI已收購Orchestra Bio，這是一款協助生物製藥團隊協調複雜藥物開發過程的平台。我們正將Orchestra的團隊與技術與Rosalind結合。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native industrial engineering workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral與NVIDIA合作開發AI原生工業工程工作流
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to integrate Mistral Large 4 and physics AI capabilities with NVIDIA accelerated computing, CUDA-X, Warp and Omniverse. The work will produce public benchmarks and open datasets for physics models and agentic AI in CAE and EDA, targeting aerospace, automotive and semiconductor workflows.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral宣布與NVIDIA合作，將Mistral Large 4與物理AI能力整合至NVIDIA加速運算、CUDA-X、Warp與Omniverse。此工作將產生物理模型與CAE/EDA代理AI的公開基準與開放數據集，目標為航太、汽車與半導體工作流。
items_flat.analysis_en: This pairs Europe’s leading open-weight frontier model with NVIDIA’s simulation stack to target domain-specific agentic workflows, potentially standardizing evaluations that general-purpose models currently lack. Real industrial adoption will depend on benchmark quality and integration depth.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將歐洲領先的開源權重前沿模型與NVIDIA模擬堆疊配對，目標為通用模型目前缺乏的領域特定代理工作流，可能標準化評估。實際工業採用將取決於基準品質與整合深度。
items_flat.quote: For too long, the pace of engineering has been set by the pace of simulation. With Mistral's open-weight models and physics AI capabilities, combined with NVIDIA’s accelerated computing stack, we’re giving engineers faster simulation cycles, as well as open benchmarks rigorous enough to validate agents on real CAE and EDA work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 長期以來，工程節奏由模擬速度決定。結合Mistral開源權重模型與物理AI能力，以及NVIDIA加速運算堆疊，我們為工程師提供更快的模擬週期，以及足以驗證真實CAE與EDA工作中代理的嚴謹開放基準。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA expands open models for language, robotics, biology and quantum
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA擴展開源模型涵蓋語言、機器人、生物與量子
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced an expanded portfolio of open models including Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt, Nemotron Retriever, Kumo for structured data, Cosmos 3.5 world models, Alpamayo 2 Edge, BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina, and Ising for quantum. Built with the Nemotron Coalition (including Mistral), the models target European sovereign AI and domain-specific customization.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA宣布擴展開源模型組合，包括Nemotron 3.5 Super VL與Bolt、Nemotron Retriever、用於結構化數據的Kumo、Cosmos 3.5世界模型、Alpamayo 2 Edge、BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina以及量子用Ising。與Nemotron聯盟（含Mistral）共建，模型瞄準歐洲主權AI與領域特定客製化。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release strengthens NVIDIA’s open-weight ecosystem for enterprise and sovereign use cases beyond pure language models. Availability timelines vary; downstream customization quality and adoption by European partners will determine impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發布強化NVIDIA超越純語言模型的開源權重生態系統，服務企業與主權用例。可用性時程不一；下游客製化品質與歐洲夥伴採用將決定影響。
items_flat.quote: NVIDIA is expanding its family of open models across language, robotics, biology, and quantum computing, giving developers, researchers and enterprises what they need to build applications tailored to local languages and industries.
items_flat.quote_zh: NVIDIA正擴展其跨語言、機器人、生物與量子運算的開源模型家族，為開發者、研究人員與企業提供打造適合本地語言與產業應用所需的工具。

openai.analysis_zh: 這顯示前沿模型對網際網路規模開源安全的高影響力貢獻，讓防禦者領先攻擊者取得時間窗口。早期洩漏風險與跨維護者、供應商及政府的複雜協調，凸顯規模化此類回應的操作複雜性。
openai.quote: Over the past two months, we led a coalition of maintainers, researchers, and security providers to address critical vulnerabilities in PHP... Calif identified a critical flaw using GPT‑5.6 Sol as part of our Patch the Planet initiative.
openai.quote_zh: 過去兩個月，我們領導由維護者、研究人員與安全供應商組成的聯盟，處理PHP重大漏洞……Calif使用GPT-5.6 Sol作為Patch the Planet倡議的一部分發現了一個重大缺陷。

openai.title_en: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries, reaching 89 total
openai.title_zh: ChatGPT廣告擴展至26個新國家，總計達89國
openai.summary_en: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT Ads to 26 additional countries (including more of Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia), bringing total availability to 89 countries. Over 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns since launch; ads appear only on Free and Go plans. The company reiterated that ads are clearly labeled, do not influence answers, and conversations remain private from advertisers.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI將ChatGPT廣告擴展至另外26個國家（涵蓋更多拉丁美洲、歐洲、非洲與亞洲），總計可用性達89國。自推出以來已有超過10萬廣告主投放；廣告僅出現在Free與Go方案。公司重申廣告清楚標示、不影響回答，且對話對廣告主保持私密。
openai.analysis_en: The expansion accelerates monetization of free users to support broader access, with a reported path toward $1B annualized ad revenue. It tests user trust as conversational ads scale, and further format or measurement expansions could shift the experience.
openai.analysis_zh: 此擴展加速免費用戶變現以支持更廣泛存取，據報有望朝向10億美元年化廣告收入。隨著對話式廣告規模化，這考驗用戶信任，進一步格式或衡量擴展可能改變體驗。
openai.quote: Today, we’re expanding ChatGPT Ads to 26 additional countries, extending availability to 89 countries worldwide... Advertising helps support free and low-cost access to ChatGPT for people around the world.
openai.quote_zh: 今天，我們將ChatGPT廣告擴展至另外26個國家，將可用性延伸至全球89國……廣告有助支持全球人們免費與低成本存取ChatGPT。

openai.title_en: OpenAI aligns safety standards across partners and updates Usage Policies
openai.title_zh: OpenAI對齊夥伴安全標準並更新使用政策
openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced work to align safety policies across services that provide its models, including partners and resellers. Updated Usage Policies (effective November 20, 2026) require prior review for model-access intermediaries and clarify rules for sensitive uses. The company introduced SafetyIDs for more precise misuse response without learning end-user identities.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布致力於對齊提供其模型之服務（含夥伴與轉售商）的安全政策。更新後的使用政策（2026年11月20日生效）要求模型存取中介服務事先審查，並釐清敏感用途規則。公司推出SafetyIDs，以便更精準回應濫用而不得知終端用戶身份。
openai.analysis_en: As OpenAI’s models become available through more third-party platforms, consistent safeguards become operationally critical. Enforcement effectiveness and partner compliance will be tested as distribution expands.
openai.analysis_zh: 隨著OpenAI模型透過更多第三方平台提供，一致的防護措施在操作上變得至關重要。隨著通路擴張，執法效力與夥伴合規將受考驗。
openai.quote: Developers and businesses should be able to choose where they access our models, with consistent safeguards across those services.
openai.quote_zh: 開發者與企業應能選擇存取我們模型的地方，並在這些服務間享有一致的防護措施。

openai.title_en: OpenAI publishes blueprint for empowering cyber defenders
openai.title_zh: OpenAI發布賦能網路防禦者的藍圖
openai.summary_en: OpenAI released Part II of its democratic governance series: a blueprint for empowering cyber defenders. It proposes clearer responsibilities for securing frontier models, modernizing cybersecurity tools and training, and strengthening public institutions for evaluations and incident reporting. This builds on prior work and the $1B Daybreak commitment for frontline defenders.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI發布民主治理系列第二部分：賦能網路防禦者的藍圖。它提出加強前沿模型安全責任、現代化網路安全工具與培訓，以及強化公共機構評估與事件報告。這建立在先前工作與為一線防禦者提供的10億美元Daybreak承諾之上。
openai.analysis_en: The blueprint frames a limited ‘defender’s window’ before advanced offensive capabilities become widespread. Concrete policy uptake by governments will determine whether the proposals translate into operational advantage.
openai.analysis_zh: 藍圖框定在進階攻擊能力廣泛普及前的有限「防禦者窗口」。政府對具體政策的採納程度，將決定這些提案能否轉化為操作優勢。
openai.quote: We are in a defender’s window: a limited opportunity to put advanced AI into defenders’ hands and strengthen protections before advanced cyber offensive capabilities become widely available.
openai.quote_zh: 我們正處於防禦者窗口：在進階網路攻擊能力廣泛可用之前，將先進AI交到防禦者手中並加強保護的有限機會。

openai.title_en: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to advance AI in drug development
openai.title_zh: OpenAI收購Orchestra Bio以推進AI藥物開發
openai.summary_en: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform that helps biopharma teams coordinate drug development with AI agents. The team and technology will join Rosalind, OpenAI’s life-sciences models and tools. The goal is to connect scientific findings with operational next steps so treatments reach patients sooner.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI收購Orchestra Bio，這是一款協助生物製藥團隊以AI代理協調藥物開發的平台。團隊與技術將加入Rosalind，即OpenAI的生命科學模型與工具。目標是將科學發現與操作下一步連結，讓治療更快到達患者。
openai.analysis_en: The deal deepens OpenAI’s vertical push into biopharma operations beyond pure research models. Integration success and measurable cycle-time reductions will show whether agentic tooling meaningfully shortens the 10–15-year drug timeline.
openai.analysis_zh: 此交易深化OpenAI從純研究模型進一步進入生物製藥操作的垂直布局。整合成功與否與可衡量的週期縮短，將顯示代理工具能否實質縮短10–15年的藥物時間軸。
openai.quote: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform that helps biopharma teams coordinate the complex process of drug development. We’re bringing Orchestra’s team and technology together with Rosalind.
openai.quote_zh: OpenAI已收購Orchestra Bio，這是一款協助生物製藥團隊協調複雜藥物開發過程的平台。我們正將Orchestra的團隊與技術與Rosalind結合。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens research preview of Claude Duet proactive agent
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic開放Claude Duet主動代理研究預覽
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic launched a research preview of Claude Duet, a standalone proactive agent app for professionals and small-business owners. Built around Claude Opus 5.5, it monitors connected apps, sends morning briefs, works in the background via a virtual machine, and requires approval for sensitive actions. Available via waitlist to US Pro and Max subscribers on iOS, Android and claude.ai; shares existing usage limits.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Duet研究預覽，這是一款針對專業人士與小企業主的獨立主動代理應用。圍繞Claude Opus 5.5打造，它監控連接應用、發送晨間簡報、透過虛擬機在背景工作，並在敏感行動前需核准。透過等待名單向美國Pro與Max訂閱者開放，支援iOS、Android與claude.ai；共用現有使用額度。
anthropic.analysis_en: Claude Duet enters a crowded field of always-on agents (OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse) with a work-focused design and strong safety emphasis. Early availability is limited; reliability of judgment on urgency and broader rollout will determine competitive impact.
anthropic.analysis_zh: Claude Duet進入擁擠的常駐代理領域（OpenAI Dots、Meta Muse），採工作導向設計並強調安全。初期可用性有限；對緊急程度判斷的可靠性與更廣泛推出將決定競爭影響。
anthropic.quote: Today, we’re opening a research preview of Claude Duet, a new app where Claude works as a proactive agent. It comes to you with what needs your attention, completes tasks you ask of it, keeps working even when you step away, and checks with you before it acts on your behalf.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天，我們開放Claude Duet研究預覽，這是一款Claude作為主動代理的新應用。它主動帶來需要你關注的事項、完成你交代的任務、即使你離開也持續工作，並在代表你行動前與你確認。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native industrial engineering workflows
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral與NVIDIA合作開發AI原生工業工程工作流
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to integrate Mistral Large 4 and physics AI capabilities with NVIDIA accelerated computing, CUDA-X, Warp and Omniverse. The work will produce public benchmarks and open datasets for physics models and agentic AI in CAE and EDA, targeting aerospace, automotive and semiconductor workflows.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral宣布與NVIDIA合作，將Mistral Large 4與物理AI能力整合至NVIDIA加速運算、CUDA-X、Warp與Omniverse。此工作將產生物理模型與CAE/EDA代理AI的公開基準與開放數據集，目標為航太、汽車與半導體工作流。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This pairs Europe’s leading open-weight frontier model with NVIDIA’s simulation stack to target domain-specific agentic workflows, potentially standardizing evaluations that general-purpose models currently lack. Real industrial adoption will depend on benchmark quality and integration depth.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這將歐洲領先的開源權重前沿模型與NVIDIA模擬堆疊配對，目標為通用模型目前缺乏的領域特定代理工作流，可能標準化評估。實際工業採用將取決於基準品質與整合深度。
frontier_other.quote: For too long, the pace of engineering has been set by the pace of simulation. With Mistral's open-weight models and physics AI capabilities, combined with NVIDIA’s accelerated computing stack, we’re giving engineers faster simulation cycles, as well as open benchmarks rigorous enough to validate agents on real CAE and EDA work.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 長期以來，工程節奏由模擬速度決定。結合Mistral開源權重模型與物理AI能力，以及NVIDIA加速運算堆疊，我們為工程師提供更快的模擬週期，以及足以驗證真實CAE與EDA工作中代理的嚴謹開放基準。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA expands open models for language, robotics, biology and quantum
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA擴展開源模型涵蓋語言、機器人、生物與量子
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA announced an expanded portfolio of open models including Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt, Nemotron Retriever, Kumo for structured data, Cosmos 3.5 world models, Alpamayo 2 Edge, BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina, and Ising for quantum. Built with the Nemotron Coalition (including Mistral), the models target European sovereign AI and domain-specific customization.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA宣布擴展開源模型組合，包括Nemotron 3.5 Super VL與Bolt、Nemotron Retriever、用於結構化數據的Kumo、Cosmos 3.5世界模型、Alpamayo 2 Edge、BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina以及量子用Ising。與Nemotron聯盟（含Mistral）共建，模型瞄準歐洲主權AI與領域特定客製化。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The release strengthens NVIDIA’s open-weight ecosystem for enterprise and sovereign use cases beyond pure language models. Availability timelines vary; downstream customization quality and adoption by European partners will determine impact.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此發布強化NVIDIA超越純語言模型的開源權重生態系統，服務企業與主權用例。可用性時程不一；下游客製化品質與歐洲夥伴採用將決定影響。
frontier_other.quote: NVIDIA is expanding its family of open models across language, robotics, biology, and quantum computing, giving developers, researchers and enterprises what they need to build applications tailored to local languages and industries.
frontier_other.quote_zh: NVIDIA正擴展其跨語言、機器人、生物與量子運算的開源模型家族，為開發者、研究人員與企業提供打造適合本地語言與產業應用所需的工具。

brief_en: OpenAI expanded enterprise reach via Google Cloud, showed multi-agent biology reasoning, coordinated PHP vulnerability response, and broadened ChatGPT Ads. Anthropic launched Claude Duet proactive agent. NVIDIA and Mistral advanced open models and industrial engineering collaboration.
brief_zh: OpenAI透過Google Cloud擴大企業通路、展示多代理生物推理、協調PHP漏洞回應並擴展ChatGPT廣告。Anthropic推出Claude Duet主動代理。NVIDIA與Mistral推進開源模型與工業工程合作。
